segments.title: Drag pinned extensions to reorder them
segments.body: Press a pinned extension in the toolbar and drag it sideways: the others slide aside, and the order you drop it in sticks, after a relaunch too. Before, nothing moved. A plain click still opens the popup.

segments.title: The same drag in the sidebar address bar
segments.body: With the address bar in the sidebar, pinned extensions sit inside the field, and they drag the same way: the others slide aside and the order sticks. Before, they stayed put there too.

segments.title: Move a hidden extension to the front
segments.body: When the sidebar is too narrow for every pinned extension, the puzzle-piece menu now has Move to Front: pick a hidden one and it takes the first place. 0.2.46's menu had no way to do that.
